description:
Consequential Work. Dedicated People.


About Onebrief

Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination.

Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real.

We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world.

Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth.

Required: Top Secret clearance with eligibility for SCI

Remote with up to 60% travel

Why This Role Exists

As a Business Development Executive - Navy at Onebrief, you will be responsible for expanding Onebrief’s presence across the U.S. Navy by identifying, developing, and capturing new business opportunities. You will leverage your understanding of Navy operations, organizational structures, acquisition processes, and existing relationships to introduce modern software and AI capabilities that transform military decision-making.

You will develop and execute strategic account plans, build relationships with senior military and civilian leaders, and identify opportunities to expand Onebrief across Navy commands, programs, and operational organizations. You will work closely with existing customers, Customer Relations, Marketing, and Product teams to turn successful deployments into broader adoption and demonstrate the operational value of Onebrief.

This role requires a combination of strategic relationship building, direct business development, and an understanding of how the Navy identifies, acquires, and implements technology. You will own your pipeline, drive opportunities from initial engagement through contract execution, and play a critical role in establishing Onebrief as a foundational capability across the Navy.

What You’ll Do

Core responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute a Navy-focused business development strategy to expand Onebrief’s presence across operational commands, Fleet organizations, Program Acquisition Executives, and other Navy stakeholders.

  • Identify, develop, and capture new business opportunities by leveraging existing relationships, industry partnerships, customer referrals, and targeted outreach.

  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior military and civilian leaders, operators, acquisition professionals, program offices, and technical stakeholders.

  • Develop strategic account plans that identify organizational priorities, decision-makers, funding sources, acquisition pathways, and opportunities for broader adoption.

  • Drive the full business development lifecycle, from initial customer engagement and opportunity qualification through pipeline development, capture strategy, and contract award.

  • Partner closely with Customer Relations to identify expansion opportunities within existing Navy customers, leverage successful deployments, and translate demonstrated mission impact into additional business.

  • Collaborate with Marketing, Product, and Growth leadership to align customer engagement, messaging, demonstrations, and go-to-market strategies with Navy priorities.

  • Stay informed on Navy modernization priorities, organizational changes, budget cycles, congressional activity, and acquisition trends to anticipate opportunities and inform growth strategies.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in U.S. Navy, Department of War (DoW), defense technology, or government-focused business development, with a demonstrated track record of developing relationships and generating revenue within government organizations.

  • Deep understanding of the U.S. Navy and its organizational structure, including major operational commands, OPNAV, Fleet Forces, systems commands, and the acquisition and budgeting processes that influence technology adoption.

  • Proven ability to identify, develop, and capture new business opportunities within the U.S. Government, including account planning, pipeline development, opportunity qualification, and contract execution.

  • Experience selling or deploying software, technology, or mission-critical capabilities to Navy or DoW customers, with the ability to translate technical capabilities into compelling operational and mission outcomes.

  • Demonstrated ability to build relationships with senior military and civilian leaders while also developing trusted relationships with operators, technical stakeholders, acquisition professionals, and contracting organizations.

  • Experience navigating complex government acquisition environments, including understanding funding mechanisms, procurement pathways, program offices, and contracting vehicles.

  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate Onebrief’s value proposition to audiences ranging from operational users to senior military leadership.

  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage a business development pipeline, prioritize opportunities, and consistently work toward revenue and growth objectives.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience selling or scaling a software or technology product across multiple U.S. Navy organizations, with a demonstrated ability to turn successful deployments into broader adoption.

  • Strong understanding of Navy modernization priorities, operational planning processes, and the technology requirements of Navy commands and organizations.

  • Established relationships across Navy operational, acquisition, and strategic organizations.

  • Experience developing and executing complex, multi-year account and capture strategies, including account mapping, pipeline development, strategic partnerships, and expansion across large government accounts.

  • Experience operating at the intersection of mission, technology, and government acquisition, with the ability to translate customer needs into actionable business opportunities.

  • Familiarity with Navy budgeting and programming processes, including the Planning, Programming, Budgeting, and Execution (PPBE) process.

  • Experience working with defense technology companies, government contractors, or emerging technology providers supporting military modernization initiatives.

Indicators of Success

This role will evolve as priorities change, but the outcomes below reflect what success typically looks like in the first six months.

A successful Business Development Executive, Navy Growth will:

  • Establish a strong understanding of Onebrief’s existing Navy footprint, customer relationships, and expansion opportunities.

  • Develop and maintain a strategic pipeline of qualified Navy opportunities with sufficient coverage to achieve assigned revenue targets.

  • Establish meaningful relationships with key Navy stakeholders across operational commands, acquisition organizations, and senior leadership.

  • Identify and advance new business opportunities that expand Onebrief’s adoption across Navy organizations.

  • Develop account strategies that connect existing customer success and demonstrated mission impact to broader Navy adoption.

  • Maintain strong alignment with Customer Relations, Marketing, Product, and Growth leadership to ensure coordinated customer engagement and effective execution of Navy growth initiatives.

Tools, Systems & Technologies

  • Salesforce

  • Government acquisition and business intelligence platforms


Notice to Third Party Recruitment Agencies
Please note that Onebrief does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of an executed Recruitment Services Agreement, there will be no obligation to any referral compensation or recruiter fee. In the event a recruiter or agency submits a resume or candidate without an agreement Onebrief explicitly reserves the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers, shall be deemed the property of Onebrief.
